paragraphs: Protech Solutions, Inc. is headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, and has developed enterprise-level systems for large, statewide agencies for 30 years. The stated focus is child support systems, homelessness, corrections, and fatherhood programs, with enterprise-level systems provided to government agencies worldwide. The pages describe an international child support system built in collaboration with The Hague Convention.
In AR, the pages claim the first web-based child support platform in the nation. A complex 46-county CSE system in SC is presented as work taken on where larger vendors failed.

Analytics are credited with boosting child support collections in the State of Maine. Hawaii's CSE system is being replatformed to better serve children and families. Digital integration is credited with revitalizing NJ's SNAP & TANF systems.

quote.text: For 30 years, we’ve transformed government technology across social services.
